newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle market not well tested - USDA.

text.p: Trading was at a standstill Friday, USDA said. Buyer inquiry was good and most seeking additional live inventory. Seller interest nil. Weekly volume 77,900. Live basis sales - Equivalent 3 percent shrink delivered and FOB, some FOB 4% shrink. Dressed basis delivered (paid on hot carcass weights)
Confirmed: 100 Last Week: Holiday Last Year: 1,500
